samples.reason: This is an open-ended creative/persuasive writing task with high latitude (composing a proposal with company brief, team descriptions, and services). Plover self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work, while Avocet has no such aversion. Plover self-reports a measurable aversion to high-latitude generative work, while Avocet has a flat preference response. Both models' Creative Generation evals are statistical near-ties (82.7 vs 78.8 is just over 2 pts, but quality is dissociated from preference), so routing to the model that isn't averse to the task type is the better fit.

Avocet shows no meaningful preference effect on output quality either, but Plover holds the Creative Generation edge.
